name: cli-terminal
purpose: The Azion CLI band of a product page: a horizontal section title with one outlined button, over a terminal session on the pixelate texture that runs off the frame's bottom rule, its lines entering one after another. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'cli-terminal', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `button`, `frame-box`, `texture-material` and `code-block`.
useWhen: To close a product argument on how little it takes to ship from the terminal, like Functions and Workloads.
avoidWhen: For a config file or handler beside the claim → use `code-split`.
For several capabilities, each with its own file → use `sticky-scroll-code`.
related: code-block` — the terminal session the band shows.
code-split` — the sibling band with the sample beside the copy.
bestPractices: Keep the session to a few commands and their output; comment the output lines so the copied text still runs.
Name the copy button with `copyAriaLabel` so a screen reader says what it copies.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the horizontal section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: session
props.doc: The terminal session shown under the header, commands and their output verbatim, highlighted as bash; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: copyAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the session's copy button; empty keeps the code block's own.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Outlined button in the section title; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CliTerminal from '@aziontech/webkit/cli-terminal'

  const session =
    'azion link --preset javascript --name auth-handler --auto\n# Project successfully configured\n\nazion deploy --auto\n# Upload completed successfully!\n# Your Application was deployed successfully\n# Domain: https://k7q2fmx4ze.map.azionedge.net\n\ncurl https://k7q2fmx4ze.map.azionedge.net/\n# Hello World'

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Install the CLI',
    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/azion-cli/overview/',
    trailing: true
  }
</script>

<template>
  <CliTerminal
    eyebrow="Azion CLI"
    title="Deploy your first function in two commands"
    description="Link a project, deploy it, and curl the domain the CLI hands back. Builds run on your machine with --local, or on Azion."
    :session="session"
    copy-aria-label="Copy the deploy session"
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
  />
</template>
